APPROVE
The logic is moved unchanged into `ReadTopLevel`, `ReadNested`, `ReadImporterLine` and `ReadPackageLine`, with locals carried in `ReadState` and `i + 1` passed as `lineNumber`, so behaviour is preserved and `Read` drops to roughly 4–8 complexity; I didn't build it, so the only open risk is a style analyzer such as StyleCop SA1401/SA1201 objecting to the public fields or nested-class placement under warnings-as-errors.
